pages.text: $(item)Firecracker Rod$() — do not imitate!$(br2)Each use has a $(#FF69B4)1/6$() chance of popping a harmless explosion effect around you. Crackling~
$(item)Fireworks Rod$() is a wearable armor piece!$(br2)While worn and used, there's a 1/5 chance to launch a $(#FF69B4)dazzling star-shaped firework$() — setting just the right mood, meow~
$(item)Tribocharging Rod$() — right-click to open the friction console and charge your rod through good old friction. Eco-friendly power generation.$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Physical power for green play!$()
